subject: Partner Solution Lab: 3-week Enablement Sprint - prep & content mapping
messages:
From: Elena Moreno <elena@consultco.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@paritylabs.com
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 3-week Partner Solution Lab for ConsultCo team

Hi Soojin,

Hope you’re well — we’re ramping up ConsultCo’s LLM practice and would like Redwood to run a focused Solution Lab for our consultants. The goal: a hands-on, 3-week enablement so our delivery teams can confidently scope and deploy Redwood-powered chat and summarization workflows for early customers.

High-level asks:
- Week 0: platform orientation (API, Dedicated vs Hosted, security controls)
- Week 1: joint design + integration patterns (embeddings, reranking, caching)
- Week 2: hands-on labs + QA templates + production checklist

Attached is our current training deck and a short list of initial customer use-cases. Can your team map content owners and confirm internal resource needs (SE time, playbook authoring, lab facilitator)?

Preferred dates: May 6–24 (we’re flexible but want to align with our May kickoff).

Thanks — Elena

—
Elena Moreno
Head of AI Partnerships | ConsultCo
elena@consultco.com | +1 415-555-0143

Attachments: consultco_current-training-deck.pptx (pptx, 5.1MB)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moreno <elena@consultco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 3-week Partner Solution Lab for ConsultCo team

Elena — thanks for the clear brief and the deck, this is right in our wheelhouse. I copied Laura (Partner Programs) and Ben (Solutions) to scope delivery.

High-level response and proposed owners:
- Orientation (Week 0): Laura to run platform & security orientation; include a short session on Private deployment requirements.
- Design patterns (Week 1): Ben to lead hands-on design labs (embeddings + reranking + caching); recommend we prepare a 90-minute deep-dive on Smart Routing and fallbacks.
- Labs + production checklist (Week 2): SE-run labs with templates and a drop-in office hour cadence; I’ll own the production checklist and rollout playbook.

Deliverables we’ll produce before kickoff:
1) Redwood enablement outline (attached) — draft mapping to your slides
2) 3-week sprint timeline (.xlsx) — clear facilitator schedule + time commitments
3) Lab exercises + evaluation rubric (draft)

One quick ask: can you confirm the size of the cohort (number of consultants) and whether they have prior infra experience (VPC/HSM)? That affects how deep we go into Private deployment content.

I attached an initial outline and timeline. We can iterate next week — propose a 30-minute alignment call on Apr 13 or 14. Available times: Apr 13 9:30–11:00 PT, Apr 14 13:00–15:00 PT.

Best,
Soojin

—
Soojin Lee
Head of Partner Enablement | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0206

Attachments: redwood_enablement-outline.pdf (pdf, 280KB); 3-week-sprint-timeline.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Elena Moreno <elena@consultco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Apr 2028 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 3-week Partner Solution Lab for ConsultCo team

Thanks Soojin — looping in logistics and enablement ops notes. A few quick coordination items:

Operational asks:
- Cohort size & roles (please confirm): consultant count, expected SE coverage per cohort, and whether pre-work will be required.
- Environment access: do you want us to provision sandbox Dedicated capacity or will your teams use hosted API keys for labs? Sandbox Dedicated needs 7 days lead time.
- Eval metrics: we’ll track two success metrics — (1) number of consults who complete a lab delivering a working integration, (2) time-to-first-PoC (internal) after the lab.

I’m sending a short Doodle link (internal) but Elena, if you prefer, share your availability and I’ll schedule. For the alignment call, we recommend a 45-min slot to walk the outline and sign off on logistics.

Laura

—
Laura Bennett
Partner Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0188

Attachments: (none)
From: Elena Moreno <elena@consultco.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@paritylabs.com
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2028 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 3-week Partner Solution Lab for ConsultCo team

Hi all — thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft materials. Confirming: cohort is 12 consultants (mixed seniority), they have basic cloud infra experience but no prior on-prem / HSM exposure. Sandbox Dedicated would be ideal but if lead time is tight we can run hosted keys for labs and then plan a private deployment workshop later.

We’re happy with the proposed owners. Please schedule a 45-min alignment call the week of Apr 24 — I’m available Apr 25 morning PT. Ben, can you include a short agenda for the design deep-dive (90-min) so we can flag any overlap with our internal curriculum?

Looking forward — Elena

—
Elena Moreno
Head of AI Partnerships | ConsultCo
elena@consultco.com | +1 415-555-0143
